what: A review lane's script signalled every process of the user session (the cause ticket #200 gives). Every agent in eight runs stopped, and each leg was remounted about two and a half hours later.

The machine reset again after the remount. Reviewers in the round under way died mid-review in three runs: four of five in #98, all three in #170, the mimo reviewers in fixture-17. Each round was relaunched or run again whole.
The mimo bug reviewer of #135's round 5 was killed by its 8G memory cap before it gave a verdict, and the round went on without it.
The first coachman of #135's review leg could not be resumed: its 41 MB session could not be replayed. The leg went to the fallback coachman on a fresh stream.

The opus security reviewer of #135's round 3 was killed by the 600-second sub-agent ceiling before its verdict. The record was written late, at the card's check; the event itself falls before the window.
The astra lane reached its codex usage limit. It left #200's workhorse branch with a spec and a blocked report and no implementation, and it failed two of fixture-37's review rounds.
The sol lane reached its codex usage limit during #218's workhorse stage and left no summary. It was resumed on its own thread at 14:12Z.
The opus security review of #57's round 5 got a 529 overloaded response and did nothing. The second attempt reviewed.
#218's mimo lane was launched twice. The coachman ended the duplicate and one lane carried on.
The host's 8G memory cap killed #218's coachman and its mimo lane. The run waited for the user's word, which came at about 14:00Z with the cap raised to 16G, and both resumed with nothing discarded.

In #200's review, the mimo bug reviewer ended round 1 with no verdict after handing its work to a background helper. In round 3 it changed the code under review and merged into the synthesis worktree, so its verdict was void, and the astra reviewer's turn failed with no verdict.
A luna bug review's findings file did not parse as JSON, in #158's round 2 and #110's round 5, and the lane's round was counted degraded.
In two fixture runs a reviewer's round was counted degraded: the opus security review made no tool call and its CLEAN was not counted, and a mimo bug report did not normalize and was read by hand.
